name: accel-balanced
description: Hardware parameters of the 2026-09-24 explorer's saved 'recommended-balanced' design (4 matrix units 32x32, 4 vector units x32 lanes, 2 recurrence units x128 lanes, 8 MiB shared L1, 460 GB/s HBM at 70%). Parameters that did not exist in that model take the engine defaults. All values are placeholders/assumptions, not a proposal from the Compute team.
